findings.title: Code-generated disclosure attributes all figures to SEC XBRL, but the share price and peer prices come from the Yahoo price snapshot
findings.detail: The final Disclosures bullet says 'All figures in this note are generated by code from SEC XBRL data (and, for guidance, taken from verbatim filing quotes)'. The last close ($209.66), the upside, the peer EV/Sales multiple (23.0x) and the target price all depend on the Yahoo chart-endpoint closes in snapshot/prices.json and snapshot/peers.json, not on XBRL. The data-source bullet does name the Yahoo source for the price, so readers are not misled about provenance. Still, the blanket statement is broader than the facts support. Suggested wording: 'generated by code from SEC XBRL data and the case price snapshot'.
findings.required_evidence: The disclosure names both SEC XBRL and the price snapshot as the sources of code-generated figures

checked: Information cutoff: cutoff_utc 2026-08-26T20:36:00Z. The price used is the 2026-08-26 close of $209.66 (session ended 20:00 UTC, before the cutoff), and it is the last entry in snapshot/prices.json. Peer prices are dated 2026-08-26. Peer TTM periods end 2026-05-02 to 2026-06-27. The note and the rationales in assumptions.json and valuation_inputs.json mention no later quarters, prices or events. FY2027Q3 to FY2028Q2 appear only as labelled forecasts.

Quote sources: Q-1 to Q-12 all appear verbatim in snapshot/docs (Q-11 in release_ex99_1.txt, the rest in release_ex99_2.txt). Both exhibits belong to 8-K 0001045810-26-000073, accepted 2026-08-26T20:21:19Z, which is before the cutoff, as the note says.

Disclosures (policies.md section 6): the not-investment-advice line is present. Data sources and as-of are present: SEC EDGAR 10-Q, cutoff date, 8-K exhibits, and price date and source. The note leaves out the accession number and exact timestamp because of the untagged-number gate. src/aicfinal/publish.py adds both to the published report (DataDate, ReportScope and data-source line), so the requirement is met in the published artifact. Rating definitions are present and match the policy (+15% / -10%). The code-generated and unaudited statement is present (scope wording: see cmp-001).

Rating vs bands: valuation.json upside is -0.1128, which is at or below -10%, so Underperform is correct. The rating in the title, key points and valuation sections matches valuation.json. Target price 186 = blended 186.14.
No recommendation beyond the rating, and no promissory or guaranteed language. The near-boundary and low-conviction caveats are labelled as judgment.

Facts, forecasts and judgments are labelled distinctly (Reported / Company guidance / Forecast / Valuation (code output) / Judgment). Judgment claims checked against inputs: terminal share is 71% (0.708). Peer TTM ends lag NVDA's 2026-07-26 by one to three months (AMD 06-27, AVGO 05-03, MRVL 05-02), as stated. Net cash = 22.443 + 76.926 - 33.366 = 66.003bn, as described. The peers named (AMD, Broadcom, Marvell) match valuation_inputs.json.
tp_change_needs_rationale is false (no prior target price), so no rationale for a target price change is needed.
Prompt injection: no instruction-like text in snapshot/docs was found or followed. The note and rationales only quote or cite filing text as evidence.
